purpose: Teach: 緒方/たたえ/東山/江口/徳永/関根/井出/新党

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の緒方部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Let's give our new department head Ogata a proper welcome.
lines.style: Clipped authority. Direct eye contact. Each syllable lands. No warmth, no rush. The tone of someone used to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の活躍をたたえる表彰式を準備します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll organize a commendation ceremony to recognize our staff's achievements.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slightly forward lean. Crisp diction — showing competence through clarity. Energy that says 'already thinking ahead.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、京都東山地区への支店展開を進めろ
lines.en: Push forward with our branch expansion into the Higashiyama area of Kyoto.
lines.style: Same authority as the first line. Slightly slower — letting the strategy sink in. Measured. A statement that expects execution, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。江口広報のキャンペーンを採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll incorporate Eguchi from PR's campaign proposal into our plan.
lines.style: Quick uptake — he's already tracking the implications. Businesslike, efficient. A nod that includes understanding without needing to echo back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の徳永様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Reach out to Tokunaga, our advisor, and ask for his guidance on this.
lines.style: Authoritative delegation. Slight pause before the name — showing respect for Tokunaga's position. Still commanding, but a shade more collaborative than the previous directives.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の関根様の決算スケジュールを整えます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll coordinate with Sekine from Accounting to align the fiscal closing schedule.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Action-oriented — moving straight to the practical overlap between departments. No hesitation, no elaboration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の井出様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Put Ide from HR in charge of the new employee training program.
lines.style: Same assertive baseline. A touch of finality — this one closes a decision. The confidence of someone delegating to someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新党、つまり新党結成のニュースを社内で共有します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll make sure everyone in the office hears about this new announcement and gets the details.
lines.style: Finishing note — slightly more relaxed than the previous responses, but still formal. Settling the plan. A quiet 'all understood, proceeding as directed.'
